claude_only.name: Within which namespace is the canonical product name unique, and which marketing or legacy names alias it?
Which organization is accountable as producer or supplier of record for this product?
Where does this product stop, and which adjacent offerings are separate products rather than editions of this one?
What Package URL type, namespace, name and qualifiers identify the distributed form of this product?
Which CPE names are asserted to denote this product, and who asserted them?
Where two identifier schemes disagree about the product boundary, which scheme is authoritative for which use?
How is a claimed coordinate verified against the published artifact before it is trusted?
Which component type from the governing BOM vocabulary applies to this product?
What primary purpose and additional purposes does the released artifact serve?
Is the product delivered as an installable artifact, an appliance image, or a hosted service, and does that change which BOM type applies?
Is the product classified as important or critical under an applicable product-security regime?
Which role owns each slice of this record: producer, supplier, distributor or operator?
Who is authorised to publish a binding statement about this product, and under what delegation?
Is the author of a given record the same party as the software producer, and how is the difference recorded?
What becomes of stewardship if the producing organization is acquired, dissolved or abandons the product?
What exact version string identifies this release, and is that string immutable once published?
When was the release published, and is that time distinct from when this record observed it?
What is the release's current state: pre-release, generally available, superseded, withdrawn or yanked?
Which event withdrew or re-published this release, and what release replaced it?
Which versioning scheme governs this product line, and is it declared by the producer or inferred by a consumer?
How is precedence determined between two versions, including pre-release identifiers and build metadata?
What change classes force a major increment, and what compatibility promise attaches to minor and patch increments?
From which authoritative download locations or registries is this release distributed?
What access conditions apply to obtaining this release: public, entitled, embargoed or jurisdictionally restricted?
How long are prior releases retained at the distribution point, and what is the removal policy?
Which hash algorithms and digest values are published for each distributable artifact of this release?
Which signing identity signed the release, and how is that identity's authority established?
What verification procedure must a consumer run before accepting the artifact, and what does a failure trigger?
Is the build reproducible, such that an independent rebuild yields a bit-identical digest?
Who authored this bill of materials, and is that party the same as the software producer?
What depth does this bill of materials claim: top level only, direct dependencies, or complete transitive closure?
Which parts of the composition are declared known unknowns rather than silently omitted?
Which bill-of-materials format and specification version does the document conform to, and was that conformance verified?
What constraint range and scope does the release declare for each dependency?
Which concrete component release satisfied each constraint at build time, and which resolver produced that resolution?
How is a later re-resolution distinguished from the resolution recorded at build time?
Is the resolved dependency set pinned by a lockfile or digest so that the build can be reproduced?
Which build platform and builder identity produced this release?
What top-level inputs, parameters and source revision entered the build?
What build-integrity level does the provenance support, and who verified that claim?
How is the provenance protected from forgery by the tenant whose build it describes?
Which secure development framework practices does the producer claim, and over what organizational and product scope?
What evidence substantiates each claimed practice, and who attested to it?
Is each claim self-attested, customer-audited or assessed by an independent third party?
What licence expression applies to this release as a whole, and in which expression syntax is it written?
Where do the declared and the concluded licences differ, and on what evidence was the conclusion drawn?
Who holds copyright in the product and who is empowered to relicense it?
Has the licence changed between releases, and does the change apply retroactively to prior releases?
Which attribution notices must ship with the product, and in what form must they be delivered?
Which contained components impose reciprocal obligations, and how far do those obligations reach into the product?
Where is corresponding source made available for components that require it, and for how long must it stay available?
What entitlement is required to obtain and run this release lawfully?
Which fields of use or deployment contexts are excluded by licence, contract or regulation?
Which export-control or sanctions classifications apply to this release, and who determined them?
Under what documented exception may a restriction be waived, and who approves the waiver?
Which identifier denotes this deployed instance in the operator's authoritative inventory?
Which release is actually running on this instance, as observed rather than as intended?
Over which time window did this instance run this release, with event time and observation time recorded separately?
What business criticality and exposure does this instance carry?
Which environment class does this host: development, test, staging, production or disaster recovery?
What platform, operating system and runtime constitute the hosting stack for this instance?
In which jurisdiction and region does hosting occur, and does that location constrain what may be processed there?
Is this instance reachable from the public internet, and through which controlled boundary?
Which security-relevant configuration values are actually in effect on this instance, and when were they last observed?
How does the effective configuration differ from the release default or the hardened baseline?
Which change event last altered this configuration, and who authorised it?
Which external services does this instance call, and are they recorded as services rather than as shipped components?
What categories of data cross each interface, and is any of it personal or otherwise regulated?
How is each interface authenticated and authorised, and where are its credentials held?
What support status applies to this release line today, and who set it?
What are the announced end-of-support and end-of-life dates, and when were they announced?
Does the declared support period satisfy the applicable regulatory minimum for the expected product lifetime?
What happens to deployed instances that remain in service after end of support, and who accepts the residual risk?
By what mechanism are security updates delivered, and are they applied automatically by default?
Are security fixes separable from feature changes so that an operator can apply one without the other?
What record proves that a given instance received and applied a given update?
Which advisory and vulnerability identifiers apply, who published them, and at which tracking version?
Which version ranges of this product are declared affected, fixed, or under investigation?
What severity or exploitability scores are asserted, by which scoring system and which scoring party?
When must an actively exploited vulnerability in this product be reported, and to which authority?
What is this product's status for the vulnerability: affected, not affected, fixed, or under investigation?
Does the assessment hold for all deployments, or only under stated configuration or environment conditions?
What triggers re-assessment, and how is a superseded assessment retained?
Which quality model and which of its characteristics are used to specify this product's quality requirements?
What measure, measurement method and target value are defined for each selected characteristic?
What values were actually measured, on which release, and under which stated conditions?
Which verification activities were performed against this release, and by whom?
How is each verification result bound to the exact artifact digest it was run against?
Which known defects were accepted as open at release, and who accepted the residual risk?
Which product-regulation regimes apply to this product in each target market, and from which date?
Which conformity assessment route was used, and who performed the assessment?
What technical documentation must exist, and for how long must it be retained after the product is placed on the market?
What declaration of conformity or marking is issued, and against exactly which release does it hold?

grok_only.name: What canonical name and short summary should agents use when referring to this product independently of a version string?
Which persistent product-line identifier groups this offering with other versions, channels or editions that are the same product over time?
Which PURL, CPE 2.3 name, SWID tag-id, SPDX IRI and SKU currently identify this product or release, and which of them is populated versus explicitly unknown?
Which identifier schemes are valid for matching this product to SBOMs, vulnerability databases and CSAF product trees, and where do those schemes disagree?
What evidence shows that each external identifier was assigned by its governing system rather than inferred by a scanner?
Which product family, edition and colloquial version line does this offering belong to, and which sibling editions share the same code base?
Which distribution or licensing channel (OEM, academic, retail, volume or other) applies to this offering?
Which CSAF product group, if any, collects this product with related products for common advisory or remediation status?
Which organization is the software creator, which is the current supplier or component producer, and which is the maintainer?
Who created the SWID/CoSWID tag or SBOM for this product, and is that party different from the component producer?
What registration URI or naming authority identifies each claimed entity so that role assertions can be correlated across documents?
What is the primary purpose of this software offering and which additional purposes apply?
Is this offering delivered as installable software, a library, a container, firmware-as-software, SaaS, or a mix, and which extra transparency elements does that mode require?
Which external service endpoints, if any, are part of the offered product's runtime trust boundary?
What UNSPSC commodity code and code-list version classify this software product?
What is the master release identifier, exact version string and version scheme for this publication?
Which release channel and pre-release or revision label apply, and is this the same product line as the stable channel?
Where is this release obtained, and which target platforms or media queries constrain its applicability?
Is this release currently published, withdrawn, yanked, superseded or still draft on the stated channel?
At what event time was the release published or withdrawn, and at what separate observation or ingestion time was that fact recorded?
Has the identification tag been revised without a new software version, and which prior release does this version supersede?
Is the current identification record a corpus, primary, patch or supplemental tag, and where is it supposed to reside (media versus endpoint versus operator overlay)?
If this is a patch, which release does it patch, and does the patch illegally change the software-version?
If this is a pre-install corpus record, which installation media or package installer does it describe?
What hash algorithms and values identify this release artifact, and is a current algorithm present rather than MD5 or SHA-1 alone?
What content identifier (SPDX contentIdentifier, gitoid, SWHID or equivalent) is bound to the artifact bytes?
Is the artifact or its SBOM signed, by whom, and does a CISA 2026 SBOM Author Signature exist distinct from the component producer?
When was this artifact built and when was it released, using RFC 3339 timestamps with seconds and an explicit offset?
Which agent originated the artifact, which supplied it, and which tool or person created the SBOM or tag?
What is the observation or ingestion time of this provenance record, and how does it differ from build and release event time?
Who authored this SBOM, with which tool and generation context, and is that author different from the component producer?
Which SBOM types apply (design, source, build, analyzed, deployed, runtime) and which data format projection and document version is this?
When was the SBOM document created, and how does that observation time differ from the described software's releaseTime?
Which element is the root product or package this bill of materials describes?
Which component or package records (WM-SFT-007) are contained in this release, and with which containment relationship?
Which intellectual-property records are referenced as component licenses, without copying license legal text into this model?
Which other products, releases or components does this release declare a need for, and are those edges direct or transitive?
What version constraint or vers range applies, and which concrete release currently resolves it?
Is each dependency required, optional or recommended, and in which scope (runtime, test or install) does it apply?
What completeness aggregate applies to this composition, and is first-party or third-party content incomplete?
Which component, dependency, license or identifier fields are explicitly unknown rather than omitted?
What horizontal and vertical coverage does the producer claim relative to CISA 2026 Coverage, and what is out of that claim?
What support level currently applies to this product or release line, and is it still within valid-until time?
When was end of life announced, when does support actually end, and how do those event times differ from the date the record was ingested?
Which 12207-aligned process (maintenance, operation or disposal) is the product in, without claiming conformance to ISO/IEC/IEEE 12207?
Which producer or maintainer organization is accountable for the support declaration?
What is the CSAF tracking identifier, document version and profile of this advisory?
Which publisher namespace and issuing authority released this advisory, and is that party the product vendor, a coordinator or a finder?
What TLP label and distribution constraints apply, and is the document in draft, interim, final or withdrawn status?
Which local products or releases are known affected, known not affected, fixed or under investigation for this advisory?
Which cited CVE or vulnerability identifiers does this assertion bind to, as external references rather than local masters?
What remediation category and URL are offered for the affected products, and on which date was that remediation published?
Does applying the remediation require a restart, and of what kind?
Which entitlements gate access to the fix, and what activation status applies to the installed product?
What is the operator master identifier of this deployed system, and which organization operates it?
Which product releases currently run on this system, and for what purpose and criticality?
When was this system deployed or decommissioned, as event times distinct from inventory observation time?
In which environment type, platform and location is this deployed system hosted?
Was presence established from producer payload, on-device evidence, or a runtime SBOM, and when was that observation collected?
Which file or image hashes were observed on the endpoint, and do they match the published release digest set?
Which operator role may read or update this inventory evidence, given that deployment detail is omitted from public product catalogues?

requirements: Resolve every provider-only bundle, layer and finding against primary evidence.
Resolve the model boundary and entry kind before accepting structure.
Verify live URLs and version pins for all accepted sources.
Record every rejected and deferred node with a reason.
Do not publish while any critical conflict remains unresolved.
